points.title: TX byte accepted
points.condition: i_tx_valid=1 and o_tx_ready=1 at an edge

points.title: TX data 0x00 accepted
points.condition: Acceptance edge with i_tx_data=0x00

points.title: TX data 0xFF accepted
points.condition: Acceptance edge with i_tx_data=0xFF

points.title: TX data 0x55 or 0xAA accepted
points.condition: Acceptance edge with i_tx_data=0x55 or 0xAA

points.title: TX back-to-back acceptance at E0+10N
points.condition: Acceptance at an edge where the previous sampled o_tx_ready was 0

points.title: TX back-to-back chain of 3 or more frames
points.condition: Back-to-back acceptance with at least two earlier back-to-back acceptances in the chain

points.title: TX acceptance after a short idle gap
points.condition: Acceptance from idle after 1 to 3 idle ready cycles without i_tx_valid

points.title: TX acceptance after a long idle gap
points.condition: Acceptance from idle after 20 or more idle ready cycles

points.title: TX offer withdrawn while busy
points.condition: o_tx_ready=0, i_tx_valid was 1 previous cycle and is 0 now

points.title: TX offer held through back-pressure then accepted
points.condition: Acceptance right at the end of a frame with i_tx_valid held from the previous cycle

points.title: TX i_tx_data changes during a frame
points.condition: o_tx_ready=0 and i_tx_data differs from previous cycle

points.title: TX frame finished, transmitter idle
points.condition: o_tx_ready=1 after a cycle with o_tx_ready=0 and no offer

points.title: Reset during a transmit frame
points.condition: Reset release after reset began while a transmit frame was active

points.title: Reset during a receive frame
points.condition: Reset release after reset began while a receive frame was in progress

points.title: Reset while a byte is held
points.condition: Reset release after reset began while o_rx_valid=1

points.title: TX byte accepted at first edge after release
points.condition: Acceptance at the first edge with i_rst_n=1 after reset

points.title: i_rxd low at reset release
points.condition: First edge after reset release with i_rxd=0

points.title: RX start bit detected
points.condition: Model start edge T0 with s(T0-1)=1 and s(T0)=0 while idle

points.title: Start-bit glitch rejected
points.condition: Model check edge T0+H with s=1

points.title: Glitch of one low sample
points.condition: Glitch rejected with line high at T0+1

points.title: Glitch of maximum length H low samples
points.condition: Glitch rejected where all samples T0..T0+H-1 were low

points.title: Start pulse of H+1 low samples accepted
points.condition: s low at T0+H with every sample from T0 low, one edge after the check

points.title: New start right after glitch
points.condition: Start detected the edge after a glitch rejection

points.title: Delivery into empty holding register
points.condition: Delivery edge with o_rx_valid=0

points.title: Delivery edge with take at V (no overrun)
points.condition: Delivery edge with o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready=1

points.title: Overrun drop at delivery edge
points.condition: Delivery edge with o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready=0

points.title: Frame error delivered into empty register
points.condition: Delivery into empty register with s(M)=0

points.title: Frame error byte dropped by overrun
points.condition: Overrun drop with s(M)=0

points.title: Frame error with take at V
points.condition: Delivery with held byte taken at V and s(M)=0

points.title: Back-to-back RX start at M+1
points.condition: Start detected the edge after the stop-bit sample M

points.title: Loaded byte 0x00 or 0xFF without frame error
points.condition: Cycle after a load with valid byte 0x00 or 0xFF and no frame error

points.title: Loaded byte 0x55 or 0xAA
points.condition: Cycle after a load with valid byte 0x55 or 0xAA

points.title: Consumer take outside a delivery edge
points.condition: o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready=1 at a non-delivery edge

points.title: Held byte stable with i_rx_ready low
points.condition: o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready=0 at a non-delivery edge

points.title: i_rx_ready high with empty register
points.condition: o_rx_valid=0 and i_rx_ready=1 at a non-delivery edge

points.title: Three or more consecutive overrun drops
points.condition: Drop with at least two earlier consecutive drops

points.title: i_rx_ready toggles while a byte is held
points.condition: o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready differs from previous cycle

points.title: Break: line low for 12 bit periods
points.condition: Synchronised line low for 12N consecutive samples

points.title: Delivery while transmitter is busy (full duplex)
points.condition: Delivery edge with o_tx_ready=0

points.title: TX acceptance while receiver is mid frame (full duplex)
points.condition: Acceptance edge while receiver is busy
